tests.title: add a book and see it in the list
tests.steps: Open the app; the list is empty. Click Add. Enter Title, Author, choose Category. Save.
tests.expect: The book appears in the list. The Lent out stat shows 0.

tests.title: reject an empty required field
tests.steps: Click Add. Leave Title empty. Enter Author, choose Category. Save.
tests.expect: The form shows 'Title is required' and does not save.

tests.title: edit an existing book
tests.steps: Pick a book in the list. Click Edit. Change Title. Save.
tests.expect: The list shows the updated Title.

tests.title: delete a book added by mistake
tests.steps: Pick a book in the list. Click Delete. Confirm.
tests.expect: The book is removed from the list.

tests.title: lend a book and show the borrower
tests.steps: Pick a book with no Borrower. Click Lend. Enter a name. Save.
tests.expect: The book shows the badge 'Lent to {Borrower}'. The Lent out stat increases by 1.

tests.title: return a book and clear the borrower
tests.steps: Pick a book that is lent out. Click Return.
tests.expect: The 'Lent to {Borrower}' badge disappears. The Lent out stat decreases by 1.

tests.title: filter to see only books that are lent out
tests.steps: With some books lent out, click the 'Lent out' filter.
tests.expect: The list shows only books where Borrower is not empty. Each shows the 'Lent to {Borrower}' badge.

tests.title: filter to see only books that are at home
tests.expect: The list shows only books where Borrower is empty. No 'Lent to' badges appear.

tests.title: see how many books are lent out right now
tests.expect: The 'Lent out' stat shows the count of rows where Borrower is not empty.

tests.title: persist data across a browser refresh
tests.steps: Add or lend several books. Refresh the browser.
tests.expect: All books, borrowers, and the Lent out stat are unchanged.

implemented_features: Add a book and see it in the list
Delete a book added by mistake
Lend a book and show the borrower
Return a book and clear the borrower
Filter to see only books that are lent out
Filter to see only books that are at home
See how many books are lent out right now
Persist data across a browser refresh
assumptions: The category select uses the three kinds the user named: Novel, Cookbook, Reference.
A book with no Borrower is considered at home; a book with a Borrower is lent out.
The headline stat is the count of books currently lent out.
Omitted due dates or overdue tracking: The idea does not mention when books are due back.
Omitted multiple copies or quantities per title: The idea treats each book as a single item.
Omitted user accounts or sharing: The idea states it is just one person on their own computer.
Omitted shelf location or cover images: The idea does not mention where a book sits or what it looks like.
Search and alphabetical sorting are provided by the scaffold and are always available.
